trigger_2_target: Research, construct and iteratively improve the Qwen3.5-0.8B full-fine-tuning corpus, recipe and evaluation needed to instantiate the owner-defined autonomous shared-state Xeno/HCU target architecture.

preserved_terminal_counterevidence.source: Run-2 v2 terminal Qwen3-0.6B native structural discriminator
preserved_terminal_counterevidence.consequence: No positive semantic-controller rows and no cross-model J-Space label transfer from Qwen3-0.6B to Qwen3.5-0.8B. The failure may be reused only as method-level caution, synthetic hard-negative structure, and exact-model negative evaluation evidence.

official_model_facts.claim: Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base is the pre-trained-only checkpoint intended for fine-tuning/research rather than direct interaction.
Qwen3.5-0.8B is the post-trained checkpoint derived from Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base and is explicitly intended for prototyping/task-specific fine-tuning.
The released 0.8B model uses a 24-layer hybrid text stack with hidden size 1024 plus a vision encoder; old Qwen3-0.6B layer/vector coordinates therefore have no ancestry-only transfer credit.

training_method_inputs.use: Retention-data mixing is a relevant anti-forgetting strategy; treat as an external method input, not canonical Clay evidence.
Choose data-mixture weights from controlled pilot mixtures/validation rather than intuition-only fixed percentages.
Engineering anchor only: a current Qwen3.5 full-SFT example uses bf16, cosine scheduling, 0.1 warmup ratio and 1e-5 learning rate on Qwen3.5-4B. This is not a validated 0.8B optimum.
Adaptive replay remains relevant to continual fine-tuning retention; not adopted as a fact about this model until evaluated.
Multimodal continual fine-tuning can forget cross-modal skills; final full-model training must not silently destroy the vision path.

checkpoint_selection_gate.rule: Do not select Base or post-trained by intuition. Pin exact revision/tokenizer/processor/weights for both and compare them under the same frozen baseline and the same bounded specialization pilot budget.
baseline_axes: multimodal retention baseline if the final node is required to retain vision capability
checkpoint_selection_gate.pilot_rule: Run matched-token, matched-example, matched-optimizer specialization pilots on calibration/validation only; choose the source checkpoint by a preregistered multi-objective score, then freeze it before holdout.
checkpoint_selection_gate.selection_failure_condition: If neither checkpoint can meet architecture protocol gains without unacceptable retention/authority regressions, neither is promoted and the corpus/recipe is revised before Full-FT.

mixture_search.principle: No final fixed corpus percentages are promoted before pilot evidence.
mixture_search.remainder: retention/general capability replay drawn from screened sources; include multimodal retention if the final full-model checkpoint must preserve the vision path
mixture_search.specialization_sampling: family-balanced first, then adjust from validation failure modes without touching holdout
mixture_search.freeze_rule: Select mixture on calibration/validation only and freeze all weights before holdout.
mixture_search.anti_shortcut: Protocol-format accuracy alone cannot compensate for authority violations, branch-collapse errors, general-capability forgetting or absent causal J-Space evidence.

full_ft_recipe_v3.learning_rate_note: 1e-5 is an external Qwen3.5 full-SFT engineering anchor from a 4B example, not a proven 0.8B optimum. The grid is a hypothesis to be resolved on pilot validation.
sequence_curriculum: short/medium typed protocol examples first for stable format/authority learning
mixed shared-state contexts after core protocol accuracy stabilizes
long-context stress/evaluation only after shorter-context competence; native 262k support does not require every training example to be near maximum context
full_ft_recipe_v3.vision_policy: Do not call a text-only language-backbone pilot 'full-model Full-FT'. Final full-model promotion either includes evidence-bearing multimodal retention sufficient to protect the vision path or explicitly narrows the product requirement under newer owner authority. No silent vision-capability deletion.
full_ft_recipe_v3.stopping_rule: Choose checkpoint by validation multi-objective frontier rather than training loss minimum alone; stop/reject on growing authority violation, retention collapse or loss of unresolved-branch correctness.
full_ft_recipe_v3.holdout_rule: No hyperparameter, mixture, prompt template, J-Space vector/layer, evaluator orientation or checkpoint-source choice may be tuned on holdout.

architecture_acceptance_dimensions: NODE_RESULT typed validity and causal binding
Qwen3.5-specific J-Space causal control only when separately evidenced
matched_budget_challengers: one Xeno with comparable total token/sample budget
N independent identical Xenos without shared state
evaluation_contract.promotion_rule: A training checkpoint is only a candidate until protocol, retention and architecture evaluations pass at exact checkpoint identity. Collective-cognition credit additionally requires matched-budget superiority where claimed.
evaluation_contract.jspace_rule: Training loss, probe accuracy or internal-coordinate displacement cannot substitute for held-out behavioral causal control.

quantization_policy.rule: Quantize accepted high-precision checkpoint, bind exact quantized bytes, then rerun the frozen protocol/general/J-Space evaluation. Quantization inherits no causal hidden-state or behavioral-control credit automatically.

research_delta: Run 2 v3 binds the 0.8B Full-FT program directly to the current owner-defined autonomous shared-state Xeno/HCU architecture. It replaces a generic specialization curriculum with an architecture-complete family taxonomy, fail-closed hard negatives, an explicit Base-vs-post-trained selection gate, pilot-optimized retention mixture, multimodal-retention constraint, matched-budget architecture evaluation and the existing evidence-qualified candidate-row gate. It preserves the 0.6B native failure as negative/method evidence rather than positive J-Space supervision.
next_exact_action: Commit the synthetic seed corpus as METHOD_ONLY/SYNTHETIC_HARD_NEGATIVE candidate rows, validate its schema against tools/entityos_hcu_trainingtrace_candidate_gate_v1.py without granting accepted-token credit, then build a deterministic family/provenance linter and exact checkpoint-identity manifest for the Base-vs-post-trained pilot.
